storage: Keep unwashed in the fridge vegetable drawer in a loose bag; cut pieces keep 2 to 3 days in a closed box.
looksLike: A glossy, hollow, blocky green pepper with 3 to 4 lobes, mild and slightly bitter-sweet, with no heat.
howToPick: Firm, glossy, heavy for its size with a fresh green stem. Avoid wrinkled skin, soft sunken spots or a dried stem.
shelfLife: About 1 week in the fridge (general guidance; not from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 40 g per serving (¼ medium capsicum, cubed)
25 g per serving (¼ medium, small pieces)
